subject: Request: FastPass demo + technical walkthrough — webinar attendee
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@cleareval.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0500
Subject: Follow-up from 'Fast inference for finance' webinar — interested in demo

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the excellent webinar this morning (Fast inference for finance). I signed up for a FastPass during the event and also spun up a trial on our account — ran a few evals and noticed jitter when we hit longer contexts.

Would love a walkthrough of the platform (ideally a 45-minute technical session) to review:
- how batching/caching would look for our latency-sensitive inference jobs
- quantization tradeoffs for our T4 fleet testbed
- data retention + audit log options for compliance

I’m based in London (GMT) and available Tue/Wed morning UK time next week. Can you send available slots or a calendar invite?

Also attaching a short note on our usage patterns (I’ll forward the file if helpful).

Cheers,
Alyssa Park
Lead ML Engineer
Cleareval Ltd
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@cleareval.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up from 'Fast inference for finance' webinar — interested in demo

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you and glad you were able to try the FastPass. I’m Jonas on the Solutions team at Redwood; happy to run the 45-minute technical walkthrough and make sure we cover the jitter you saw.

Quick options (all in GMT):
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:45 GMT
- Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:45 GMT
- Wed 25 Nov, 09:30–10:15 GMT (shorter if you prefer)

If none of those work, you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-fastpass/45min

I’m attaching a short FastPass one-pager with what we cover in the session and a checklist we typically use to validate latency regressions. Tessa (copied) is our onboarding specialist and will join to dig into telemetry / tracing.

Agenda suggestion for the 45-min session:
1) Quick architecture recap (5)
2) Reproduce the jitter pattern + root-cause hypotheses (15)
3) Walkthrough of batching, prefix caching, and quantization knobs (15)
4) Next steps / mutual action plan (10)

Let me know which slot you prefer and any specific datasets or logs you want us to preview ahead of time.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199
Attachment: fastpass-onepager.pdf (PDF)

Thanks Jonas — Tue 24 Nov at 11:00 GMT works for me.

Couple of things before we lock in:
- Can you confirm 11:00 GMT is the same as 06:00 EST? I’m double-checking internal calendars.
- We need a short note on data retention and audit logs for procurement (SOC2 scope) — Tessa’s input will be great.
- I can share a sample log export from our trial run; should I paste it in email or upload somewhere?

Also, please send a calendar invite with dial-in details (we prefer Zoom).

Best,
Alyssa

Perfect — thanks, Alyssa. I’m confirming Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:45 GMT (that is Tue 24 Nov, 06:00–06:45 PST / 09:00–09:45 EST). I’ve created a calendar event and included a Zoom link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Tessa — can you bring the SOC2 + audit-log checklist and we’ll call out any evidence lanes Cleareval will need for procurement?

Alyssa — please upload the trial log export to the shared HubSpot file for your company or reply to this thread with the file. If you’d rather we take it offline, we can also provide a secure SFTP drop.

Attaching our integration checklist so you have a pre-call checklist: integration-checklist.xlsx (XLSX).

See you on Tue 24 — calendar invite should hit your inbox in a few minutes.

Thanks,
Jonas
